name: tollbooth_pricing_quote
title: Pricing & Net Revenue Quote
description: Compute clearinghouse fee and developer net payout across Free BYO x402 (0%), Hybrid (7%), and Tollbooth Pro/Agency (3%) tiers in integer USD microdollars.

priceMicros.description: Per-call price in integer USD microdollars (1 USD = 1000000 microdollars, e.g., 10000 for $0.01).

callsPerMonth.description: Estimated monthly paid API or MCP tool calls.

name: tollbooth_wallet_balance
title: Check Wallet Credit Balance
description: Inspect an agent wallet credit balance, status, and remaining UTC daily spend cap. Read-only. Needs the wallet key for that wallet (Authorization: Bearer rcs_wk_...).

walletId.description: Agent wallet identifier to inspect (e.g., wallet_demo).

name: tollbooth_issue_receipt
title: Issue Signed Bearer Receipt
description: Issue a short-lived Rail B rcs_receipt bearer token (Ed25519-signed, verifiable with /.well-known/tollbooth-jwks.json) that spends from an existing prepaid wallet balance. Needs the wallet key for that wallet. Does not move bank or crypto funds.

developerId.description: Recipient API developer identifier registered in the clearinghouse.

audience.description: Target URL path, route pattern, or '*' wildcard audience bound to the receipt.

method.description: HTTP verb constraint (e.g., GET, POST) or '*'.

amountMicros.description: Maximum debit amount in integer USD microdollars.

scheme.description: Payment authorization scheme ('exact' fixed charge or 'upto' metered ceiling).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate debit charges on retries.

name: tollbooth_verify_x402
title: Verify x402 V2 Payment Header
description: Verify an x402 V2 exact payment: EIP-712 TransferWithAuthorization signature recovered against the payer, USDC asset and network, recipient, amount, expiry and replay records. Read-only; does not execute on-chain transfers.

paymentPayload.description: Decoded x402 V2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE JSON payload object.

paymentRequirements.description: Accepted payment requirements object specifying amount, network, and payTo address.

name: tollbooth_create_topup_checkout
title: Generate Checkout Link URL
description: Return a Stripe Checkout or sandbox link URL that a user can open in a browser to fund a wallet ($1+) or purchase a Pro ($39) / Agency ($79) Pass. Never charges automatically.

walletId.description: Agent wallet identifier to top up via Stripe Checkout.

developerId.description: Developer identifier for Pro ($39) or Agency ($79) pass upgrades.

passTier.description: One-time developer tier upgrade to unlock 3% clearinghouse fee.

name: tollbooth_register_wallet
title: Register Agent Wallet
description: Create an empty prepaid Fiat Agent Wallet and return its wallet ID and wallet key (shown once). Moves no money; fund it later with tollbooth_create_topup_checkout.

label.description: A name for the wallet, such as the agent it pays for.

email.description: Optional owner email for receipts and recovery.

dailySpendCapUsd.description: Daily spend cap in USD. Default 25.

name: tollbooth_ledger_history
title: Ledger History
description: List recent ledger entries (top-ups, charges, settlements) for a wallet or a developer account, newest first. Read-only. Needs that account's wallet or developer key.

walletId.description: Wallet to list (use with a wallet key).

developerId.description: Developer account to list (use with a developer key).

name: tollbooth_pass_status
title: Pass Status
description: Show a developer account's tier (hybrid, pro or agency), its Fiat Agent Wallet fee rate and whether upto metering is on. Read-only. Needs the developer key.
